decisions.Kwic: 復舉：「巴陵鑒禪師，有僧問：『如何是提婆宗？』陵云：『銀碗裏盛雪。』

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, Xueguan Zhiyin's informal address raising Baling's three turning phrases. Baling Haojian is the exact speaker of the stored answer: after an unnamed monk asks what the Kanadeva school is, the quoted case marks Baling's reply with 陵云, 'snow heaped in a silver bowl.'

decisions.Kwic: 直下便見，無第二人，擬議即乖，焉容鈍置？

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, repentance-hall informal address. Xueguan Zhiyin is the exact speaker: describing original-ground scenery, he says it is seen directly with no second person and that deliberation immediately goes astray.

decisions.Kwic: 忽有箇一絲不掛的漢子出來，還教伊脫箇甚麼？

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, instruction on relinquishing what is prized. Xueguan Zhiyin is the exact speaker: after comparing the process to stripping off clothing layer by layer, he asks what could still be removed from a person with not one thread attached.

decisions.Kwic: 進云：「如何過得這重關？」師云：「問取把關吏。」

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, end-of-retreat public exchange. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: after Xueguan rejects his comparison of the retreats, the monk advances and asks how to pass this heavy barrier; Xueguan tells him to ask the barrier guard. The six-rung review found no personal name for this monk.

decisions.Kwic: 僧：「如何是寶鏡三昧？」師：「不照閒光影，還他舊面皮。」

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, concise public exchange. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks what the precious-mirror samadhi is, and Xueguan Zhiyin answers that it does not reflect idle lights and shadows but returns the old face. The six-rung review found no personal name for this monk.

decisions.Kwic: 不惟善能解脫塵勞一絲不掛，且爾直入無上菩提如箭射鵠、如刀破竹

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, Xueguan Zhiyin's prose instruction for a layman named Shi. Xueguan Zhiyin is the exact author: he says that equal regard toward good and bad circumstances not only frees one from dusty toil with not one thread attached but also permits direct entry into unsurpassed awakening.

decisions.Kwic: 呈方丈和尚生鐵鑄錘安虎膽，黃金烹汁淬龍泉

Decision.AttributionNote: 雪關禪師語錄, Xueguan Zhiyin's verse titled 'Presented to the Abbot Elder' (呈方丈和尚). Xueguan Zhiyin is the exact author of the headword-bearing title and its verse; the abbot is the named role of the addressee, not the verse's speaker.
